propositions: Test oracle for per-event commit resolution returns None on transient Git read failure while batched-side recovers, causing equivalence assertion to compare exact SHA against None
Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors, empty results, and exceptions to None and must retain fail-closed contract; recovery is fixture-only
Test fixture retried batched Git walk but not the per-event equivalence oracle, requiring bounded retry helper to match batched-side resilience
Bounded per-event oracle helper must return only non-None SHA after at most five identical retry attempts and raise with diagnostics on persistent failure
All batched/per-event exact SHA equivalence assertions must route through the bounded oracle helper while leaving production behavior unchanged
